definitions.explanation: The feeling of regret or anger at one's own failure or inability to do something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{負|ま}けた→負ける：01134_makeru⟧{悔|くや}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦バネ→ばね：00011_bane⟧⟦にして→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}した→練習：05323_renshuu⟧。
examples.english: I used the frustration of losing as motivation to practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{悔|くや}しさ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦でも→でも：00925_demo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れられない→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧。
examples.english: I still can't forget the frustration from that time.

notes:
{悔|くや}しさ is the noun form of ⟦{悔|くや}しい→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧.

FORMATION:
⟦{悔|くや}しい→悔しい：02343_kuyashii⟧ (i-adjective) → {悔|くや}しさ (noun)

NUANCE:
Combines frustration at failure, anger at oneself, regret, and sometimes competitive drive.

COLLOCATIONS:
・{悔|くや}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ - to feel frustration
・{悔|くや}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦バネ→ばね：00011_bane⟧⟦にする→する：00392_suru⟧ - to use frustration as motivation
・{悔|くや}しさ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦こみ{上|あ}げる→込み上げる：10335_komiageru⟧ - frustration wells up
・{悔|くや}しさ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{泣|な}く→泣く：00655_naku⟧ - to cry from frustration

SIMILAR EMOTION NOUNS:
